sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever sheared my sheep.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次自己剪羊毛。

sentences.en: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her kitchen shears.
sentences.zh: Ziri问Rima是否能借用她的厨房剪刀。

sentences.en: Ziri asked Yazid if he could borrow his hedge shear.
sentences.zh: Ziri问Yazid是否能借用他的修枝剪。
